name: OpenVibe.Rent
description: OpenVibe.Rent is a rental aggregator: one search opens Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, Zillow, Apartments.com, Zumper, Rent.com and more at the place and filters you choose, for apartments, houses, rooms, stays, commercial space, parking, storage and cars. Next to them: affordable housing from U.S. HUD open data, listings people post here, and alerts through OpenVibe.Watch. Listings, messages and payments stay on each site. A board keeps the listings you like from any site in one list, and the OpenVibe Companion browser extension adds them in one click.

pillars.title: Search every site
pillars.text: One place and filters open Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, Zillow, Apartments.com, Zumper and more at once.

pillars.title: Your board
pillars.text: Keep listings from any site in one list, with your notes and how far you got.

pillars.title: Affordable housing near you
pillars.text: Public housing, tax-credit and HUD-assisted homes and where to apply, from U.S. HUD open data.

pillars.title: Posted here too
pillars.text: Apartments, rooms, houses, commercial space, parking, storage and equipment, posted by people on OpenVibe.Rent.

pillars.title: Alerts
pillars.text: Get alerts for any search through OpenVibe.Watch.

pillars.title: Your account
pillars.text: Your listings and saved searches under your OpenVibe account.

faq.question: Who posts the listings?
faq.answer: People with an OpenVibe account. In this first version nothing is copied from other listing sites; sources whose terms allow it come later, each named and linked.

faq.question: Does OpenVibe take payments or deposits?
faq.answer: No. A listing carries a way to contact the person who posted it and nothing more. Never pay or send a deposit before you have seen the place and signed an agreement.

faq.question: Why can't I add my street address?
faq.answer: For your safety: a listing names a city and, if you like, a neighbourhood. A street address is refused.

faq.question: How long does a listing stay up?
faq.answer: Thirty days. You can renew it, edit it, hide it or delete it at any time.

faq.question: What happens when a listing is reported?
faq.answer: Three reports from different people hide it until OpenVibe staff look at it and restore or remove it.

keywords: openvibe rent, rental search, apartments for rent, rooms for rent, commercial rentals, rental alerts
